questions.e: Halima Sadia of Banu Sa'd nursed and raised the infant Prophet (SAW) in the desert. Past PMA LC question.

questions.q: Which title is given to Hazrat Usman (RA) for compiling the Quran in a single standard volume?
questions.e: Hazrat Usman (RA) had the Quran compiled in one standard text, so he is called Jami-ul-Quran. Past PMA LC question.

questions.q: Which two main Arab tribes of Madinah (Yathrib) were reconciled after the Prophet's (SAW) arrival?
questions.e: The Arab tribes Aus and Khazraj lived in Madinah and became the Ansar after accepting Islam. Past PMA LC question.

questions.q: Which wife of the Prophet (SAW) was the daughter of Hazrat Umar (RA)?
questions.e: Hazrat Hafsa bint Umar (RA) was the daughter of Hazrat Umar (RA) and a wife of the Prophet (SAW). Past PMA LC question.

questions.q: What is the shaving of the head during Hajj called?
questions.e: Halq is shaving the head (taqsir is trimming) performed after stoning to leave the state of Ihram. Past PMA LC question.

questions.q: By which other name is the Battle of Khandaq also known?
questions.e: The Battle of Khandaq is also called the Battle of Ahzab because several tribes united as allies against Madinah. Past PMA LC question.

questions.q: Who was the commander of the Quraish at the Battle of Khandaq?
questions.e: Abu Sufyan bin Harb led the Quraish and their allies at Khandaq; the others had died before that battle or did not lead it. Past PMA LC question.

questions.q: What were the approximate strengths of the two sides in the Battle of Khandaq?
o: About 3,000 Muslims against about 10,000 allied forces
questions.e: About 3,000 Muslims defended Madinah against an allied army of about 10,000. Past PMA LC question.

questions.q: In which year of the Hijri calendar was the Ghazwa of Tabuk fought?
questions.e: The expedition to Tabuk against the Romans took place in 9 AH (630 AD) with about 30,000 Muslims. Past PMA LC question.

questions.q: In which year of the Hijri calendar did fasting in Ramadan become obligatory?
questions.e: Fasting in Ramadan was made obligatory in 2 AH, the same year as the Battle of Badr. Past PMA LC question.

questions.q: Who commanded the Muslim army against Musaylima at the Battle of Yamama?
questions.e: During the caliphate of Hazrat Abu Bakr (RA), Khalid bin Waleed (RA) led the Muslims at Yamama, where many huffaz were martyred. Past PMA LC question.

questions.q: In which year of the Hijri calendar was the Battle of Hunain fought?
questions.e: The Battle of Hunain took place in 8 AH after the conquest of Makkah. Past PMA LC question.

questions.q: In which year of the Hijri calendar did Zakat become obligatory (as given in standard textbooks)?
questions.e: Textbooks state that Zakat was made obligatory in 2 AH in Madinah. Past PMA LC question.

questions.q: In which year of the Hijri calendar was the Battle of Mu'tah, fought against the Byzantines, held?
questions.e: The Battle of Mu'tah against the Byzantine forces took place in 8 AH (629 AD). Past PMA LC question.

questions.q: In which year of the Hijri calendar did Hajj become obligatory (as given in standard textbooks)?
questions.e: Textbooks state that Hajj was made obligatory in 9 AH, and the Prophet (SAW) performed his only Hajj in 10 AH. Past PMA LC question.

questions.q: In which year of Prophethood did the first migration (Hijrat) to Abyssinia take place?
questions.e: The first group of Muslims migrated to Abyssinia in Rajab of the 5th year of Prophethood. Past PMA LC question.

questions.q: At about what age did the Prophet Muhammad (SAW) migrate from Makkah to Madinah?
questions.e: The Prophet (SAW) was about 53 years old at the time of the Hijrah in 622 AD. Past PMA LC question.

questions.q: How many times is the name Muhammad mentioned in the Quran?
questions.e: The name Muhammad appears four times in the Quran, in Surahs Aal-e-Imran, Al-Ahzab, Muhammad and Al-Fath. Past PMA LC question.

questions.q: What is the Nisab (minimum limit) for Zakat on gold?
questions.e: Zakat is due on gold at 2.5 percent once a person holds at least 7.5 tola (about 87.48 g); 52.5 tola is the silver Nisab. Past PMA LC question.

questions.q: How old was the Prophet (SAW) when he took part in the Harb al-Fijar (Jang-e-Fijar)?
questions.e: The Prophet (SAW) was about 15 years old at the time of Harb al-Fijar, where he helped his uncles by handing them arrows. Past PMA LC question.

questions.q: Which Sahabi conquered Egypt during the caliphate of Hazrat Umar (RA)?
questions.e: Amr bin al-As (RA) led the Muslim army that conquered Egypt around 640 AD. Past PMA LC question.

questions.q: According to Hanafi fiqh, how many farz acts are there in Hajj?
questions.e: Ihram, Wuquf-e-Arafah and Tawaf-e-Ziyarat are counted as the three farz of Hajj. Past PMA LC question.
